panels.title: How runs end
panels.about: Every verdict this pipeline has recorded, and what each cost. ABANDONED is not a verdict about the work: it is what a run is called when nothing reported on it for longer than a run is allowed to take.
queries: SELECT coalesce(nullif(verdict,''),'(none)') AS verdict, count(*) AS runs, round(sum(usd),2) AS usd, sum(turns) AS turns, round(avg(coalesce(finished,started)-started)/60,1) AS avg_minutes FROM runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: Runs finished, by day
panels.about: One line per verdict. A day with more red than green is a day to go and read, and the shape over weeks is the only thing that says whether any of this is improving.
queries: SELECT cast(strftime('%s', date(finished,'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS time, coalesce(nullif(verdict,''),'(none)') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM runs WHERE finished IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: What a run costs, by day
panels.about: Total and average. The average is the one that answers whether a change made runs cheaper; the total is the one that answers whether it mattered.
queries: SELECT cast(strftime('%s', date(started,'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS time, 'spent that day' AS metric, round(sum(usd),2) AS value FROM runs GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT cast(strftime('%s', date(started,'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER), 'average per run', round(avg(usd),2) FROM runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Turns a run takes, by day
panels.about: Counted from what the model actually returned, not from tool calls: a tool call was reported as a turn for a while and the number ran two to three times over.
queries: SELECT cast(strftime('%s', date(started,'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS time, 'average per run' AS metric, round(avg(turns),0) AS value FROM runs WHERE turns > 0 GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT cast(strftime('%s', date(started,'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER), 'the longest that day', max(turns) FROM runs WHERE turns > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Where the money goes, over all runs
panels.about: Every agent that has ever cost anything, dearest first, with what it charges per session. One phase at thirty-four dollars of a fifty-nine dollar run is the kind of thing only this view shows.
queries: SELECT json_extract(payload,'$.agent') AS agent, count(*) AS sessions, round(sum(json_extract(payload,'$.usd')),2) AS usd, round(avg(json_extract(payload,'$.usd')),3) AS usd_each, round(sum(json_extract(payload,'$.seconds'))/3600,1) AS hours FROM events WHERE kind='session_end' AND json_extract(payload,'$.agent') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING usd > 0 ORDER BY usd DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: What every limit has caught
panels.about: Each rule, how often it has fired and what was done about it. A rule that has never fired is either a limit nothing reaches or a limit nothing can reach — and the second kind is worth finding.
queries: SELECT rule, action, count(*) AS times, round(min(observed),1) AS smallest, round(max(observed),1) AS largest, max(threshold) AS threshold FROM judgements WHERE action <> 'started' GROUP BY rule, action ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: Gates, over all runs
panels.about: How often each check refuses, and how long its repair takes. The difference between a gate that earns its cost and a tollbooth is these two numbers.
queries: SELECT phase, count(*) AS rounds, sum(verdict='red') AS red, sum(verdict='green') AS green, sum(findings) AS findings, round(avg(seconds)/60,1) AS avg_minutes FROM gates GROUP BY phase ORDER BY rounds DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: What every run did twice
panels.about: The same call, across every run there has been. Counted rather than remembered: a branch read one step module twenty times and ran the same search eleven, and nobody knew until somebody counted by hand.
queries: SELECT kind, count(*) AS calls, count(DISTINCT signature) AS distinct_calls, count(*) - count(DISTINCT signature) AS repeats FROM calls GROUP BY kind ORDER BY calls DESC
